study: Do the desk's square arms do worse when price is inside, or just under, an overhead order block that was already known at the decision?
registered_at: 2026-10-05 (during RTH; nothing run until after the close), before any order-block feature was computed on the sample
origin: Operator, 10/5: ETHA and EWZ losses 'did not move out of the resistance' (LuxAlgo Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks). Port check the same day: EWZ 10:11 entry was inside a bearish OB (43.39-43.95) known since 08:09 (would flag); ETHA's zone (20.49-20.59) became known at 10:35, after the 10:13 entry (would NOT flag). TradingView draws boxes back to the origin candle, which looks like look-ahead on a chart.
indicator: tools/order_blocks.py, a point-in-time port of 'Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks [LuxAlgo]' with default inputs (swing lookback 10, wicks). A block is usable only from the close of the bar that confirmed it. Port checked to the cent against the operator's ETHA 5m and EWZ 1m charts on 10/5.
sample: the 2026-10-02 indicator-levels sample, unchanged (ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json, ext.pkl): E = 1,807 square arms at $10+, 09:40-15:30, 9/04-10/02, one per name per 15 min; F = 348 desk fills at $10+ since 9/23. Outcome net15 = 15 min after entry minus 0.20% round trip, as registered then. These days have been used for other level features, never for order blocks.
feature: RESIST = the price at the decision is inside, or within 0.3% below, a resistance block known before the decision: an unbroken bearish OB, or a bullish breaker (a broken bullish OB). Blocks are computed on the prior day + today, extended hours, from 1-minute SIP bars.
primary: E arms, 1-minute bars, within 0.3%: net15 of RESIST arms minus net15 of the other arms, OLS on a RESIST dummy, day-clustered t, separately in halves A and B (alternate trading days, as on 10/02).
pass: diff <= -5 bp AND t <= -2 AND >= 50 RESIST arms, in BOTH halves. A pass earns a held-out confirmation on >= 10 new sessions (10/5 onward) before any config change; it is not a gate yet.
information_only: E and F on 5-minute bars (resampled from the same 1-minute)
F (fills): net15 and realized round trip, flagged vs rest
share of arms flagged (the opens a skip rule would cost)
no_retuning: the 0.3% band, swing length 10, the timeframe and the resistance definition are fixed here; any change is a new pre-registration
prior: low-moderate. 10/02: no S/R level separated arms reliably; the only same-sign fill cell was 'just under the prior-day high' (n 22/15). Order blocks are new.
caveats: port is from the published logic as remembered; checked on two charts only
net15 is a fixed 15-minute hold, not the desk's trail exit
